description: This PHP source file defines the 'ViewModule' class, a subclass of 'SugarView', which manages the display and interaction logic for the Module Builder interface in SuiteCRM. It handles rendering templates, loading module packages, and providing UI navigation crumbs for module creation or modification.

classes.name: ViewModule
classes.description: A view class that manages the display and interaction of the Module Builder interface within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Returns parameters for the module title, translating 'LBL_MODULE_NAME' for the 'Administration' context.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Prepares and renders the module builder interface, including loading modules, setting up Smarty templates, and generating navigation breadcrumbs.

methods.name: loadPackageHelp
methods.description: Sets help context for the module package, distinguishing between creation and modification states.
